unmapped_element_count.measurement: Count of defined elements (from 02-define.json) that have no valid target position in the Unified Template structure. Range: 0-19.

structural_gap_count.measurement: Count of target layers (from US handoff 24-layer invariant set) that have NO source content to map from — content must be created from scratch. Excludes fields within existing structures (those are field_deficit). Range: 0-24.

field_deficit_count.measurement: Count of required fields within mapped structures that are missing or use non-standard names requiring rewrite. Process table: 2 missing (Medium, Authority). HEIR: 7 missing. Range: 0-18.

merge_collision_count.measurement: Count of target positions where multiple source sections must merge, creating risk of content loss or structural conflict during restructuring. Range: 0-14.

unresolved_mapping_count.measurement: Count of mappings typed as 'unresolved' — elements that exist in the define artifact but whose target content must be authored (not just moved or renamed). These are the hardest gaps: no source content exists to transform. Range: 0-19.
